name: Investigation Request 50
definition: Specifies the details of an investigation request, including identification and type.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the requestor, and sent to the responder to unambiguously identify the message.|Usage: The requestor has to make sure that MessageIdentification is unique per responder for a pre-agreed period.

RequestorInvestigationIdentification.name: Requestor Investigation Identification
RequestorInvestigationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the requestor, to unambiguously identify the investigation for the requestor.

ResponderInvestigationIdentification.name: Responder Investigation Identification
ResponderInvestigationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the responder, to unambiguously identify the investigation for the responder.

EIR.name: EIR
EIR.definition: Unique identifier to provide the end-to-end reference of an investigation.

RequestAction.name: Request Action
RequestAction.definition: Specifies an action the responder should now take in regard to the investigation and the reason for the action.

InvestigationSubType.name: Investigation Sub Type
InvestigationSubType.definition: Sub type of an investigation.||Usage: The investigation sub type element may be used to identify a department within an agent to whom the investigation can be directed to, for routing purposes. It should only be used when the investigation type could logically be directed to different departments within an agent, for example a request for information.

UnderlyingInstrument.name: Underlying Instrument
UnderlyingInstrument.definition: Specifies the instrument or product to which the investigation refers.

Underlying.name: Underlying
Underlying.definition: Provides details on the subject to which the investigation refers, for example a payment or statement entry.

Requestor.name: Requestor
Requestor.definition: Identification of the agent or party requesting a new investigation is opened or status update for an existing investigation.

Responder.name: Responder
Responder.definition: Identification of the agent or party expected to open a new investigation or provide a status update for an existing investigation.

RequestOriginator.name: Request Originator
RequestOriginator.definition: Identification of the agent or party who has originated the request.||Usage: When the Requestor has forwarded the investigation from another party, it is recommended to provide the RequestOriginator in this element.

ExpectedResponder.name: Expected Responder
ExpectedResponder.definition: Identification of the agent or party who the requestor of the investigation expects the responder to contact in relation to the investigation request.

ServiceLevel.name: Service Level
ServiceLevel.definition: Specifies a pre-agreed service or level of service between the requestor and responder.

ResponderInvestigationIdentificationGuid.definition: Where the ResponderInvestigationIdentification has previously been provided to the requestor as part of an earlier response the ResponderInvestigationIdentification should be present.
